moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description:
Normal (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Shed Tail
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 2
The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description:
Normal (Special)
Base Power: 50
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description:
Electric (Special)
Base Power: 55
Accuracy: 95
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

items.name: Shuca Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ground-type attack. Single use.

abilities.name: Dry Skin
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.description: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and it loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.description: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
